units.source_text: 说一家十六口人，是包括这些弟子在内的。

en.t: When they said the household had sixteen people, that included these disciples.

units.source_text: 内弟子有四五人，但年轻棋手只有大竹七段一人。

en.t: There were four or five live-in disciples, but among the young go players there was only Otake, seventh dan.

units.source_text: 足见他有很好的人缘和收入。

en.t: This shows that he was well liked and had a good income.

units.source_text: 再说，大竹七段是个溺爱孩子和体贴家眷的人，因而就出现了这种情形吧。

en.t: Besides, Otake, seventh dan, was a man who doted on his children and was considerate toward his family, so that is probably how this situation came about.
